issues.label: Agent-native semantic GPU debugger and profiler
Deterministic CPU semantic simulator and virtual GPU runtime

capabilities.label: Rust ownership and result flow
capabilities.detail: rustc remains the only Rust borrow checker: it enforces moves, borrows, lifetimes, visibility, and local typestate. Fe2O3 extends those rules with sealed non-Clone GPU capabilities and workload-neutral cross-invocation verification. Typed kernels may return KernelResult and use ?, while the macro emits a private unit-ABI entry wrapper and the compiler retains the helper's real MIR. Err ends only the current invocation and is not a host-visible error channel.

capabilities.label: Pliron context ownership
capabilities.detail: Process-local context identities, registered dialects, and context-bound handles are checked before operations are inspected. Generic safety passes execute today; issue #140 tracks stronger owner-aware upstream arena handles rather than blocking the production verifier sequence.

capabilities.label: Generic pre-lowering safety
capabilities.detail: The fixed eight-pass workload-neutral pre-lowering sequence verifies rooted tensor-layout composition, ranked bounds and checked machine-index arithmetic, atomic legality, cross-invocation race freedom, complete hierarchy ownership, barrier and SIMT collective protocol convergence, workgroup-memory initialization/publication, and semantic refinement. The semantic stage now fails closed on unproved loop progress and on changed numerical operator trees without an error theorem. A separate compiler-supplied target precondition checks launch geometry, static LDS use, and origin-bound host allocation size and alignment before the same eight passes; it grants no launch authority. Compiler-derived tensor roots connect producers to operand and accumulator consumers; incompatible ABI flow and producer joins are compile-time errors. Every diagnostic includes a concrete repair or states the missing proof obligation. Rejected and Incomplete findings both stop production compilation before lowering.

capabilities.label: Unified production route
capabilities.detail: Ordinary safe Rust reaches semantic MIR, ranked PLIRON verification, canonical Kernel IR V7, and formal-memory admission through the sole unselected production route. Current main has removed the alternate qualification host applications and the source-first `cargo fe2o3 simulate` route so future source execution must complete through that one production architecture. The pinned dynamic GEMM, row-softmax, fused-attention, and grouped-expert MI300X results remain historical observations from commit af0fd523e3b774377a9c5192cf0511e34fa19735, not current launch commands. Unsupported effects and ownership forms remain deliberately fail-closed, and obsolete pipeline selectors are rejected.

capabilities.label: Bounded compiler analysis
capabilities.detail: Closed control-flow validation, pruned SSA placement, block-argument uniformity, sparse index facts, compiler-derived tensor-layout roots, dynamic tiled-component reasoning, subgroup-scoped bounded invocation traces with finite loop-carried environments, Result and Option payload dominance, and stable diagnostics feed every workload through the same safety pipeline. One ephemeral manager caches eight roots for each production run. A separate bounded integrity layer combines a context-wide monotonic PLIRON mutation-attempt epoch with one initial and eight post-stage exact structural checkpoints. Any mutation attempt during an analysis-only stage fails closed and is attributed to that stage, including mutate-then-restore and failed mutable-borrow attempts; exact canonical bytes still locate a retained change and support revalidation. SHA-256 labels remain diagnostic only. Each of the eight analysis reports is also sealed to its exact context, function, checkpoint, stage position, implementation, configuration, payload, and status. That custody detects substitution and tampering, but all eight independent semantic-witness checks remain Incomplete, so a Clean policy result is diagnostic and grants no proof, lowering, artifact, or launch authority. Genuinely transforming passes use a separate before/after refinement boundary; zero production transformations are supported until an independent semantic checker exists. The Presburger service models finite integer boxes, signed affine equalities and inequalities, constant-modulus congruences, affine or remainder maps, and signed or unsigned machine ranges. Bounds, race, and hierarchy-ownership passes use it for overflow and range witnesses, relation disjointness, and coverage. Bounded acyclic pure helper effects are summarized interprocedurally; recursive, opaque, inline-assembly, or unresolved memory-effecting calls fail closed. Closed typed scalar SSA binds Boolean, signed/unsigned integer, and f32/f64 operators, casts, overflow, rounding, exceptional values, static definedness, and canonical commitments. None of these analyses recognizes GEMM, softmax, attention, routing, or another workload.

capabilities.label: Safe Rust functional references
capabilities.detail: The published compiler baseline runs one generated Verus checker that replays supported exact pointwise integer and compiler-side IEEE operator-DAG formulas from compiler-derived coordinates, domains, preconditions, and values; no generic relation premise supplies equality. PLIRON separately proves and reconciles total coverage, allocation separation, frames, schedules, and ordered-product identity, while a private move-only join requires both structural and formula reports. Status-Checked policy staging grants no authority. Canonical positive-step loops carry termination evidence only when the backedge update is statically nonwrapping; concrete nontermination is Rejected and an unsupported ranking proof is Incomplete. Dynamic slice reads are complete only for exact identical symbolic ranked extents or overflow-checked bounded static affine intervals; unrelated independent lengths, missing assertions, unsafe intervals, and overflow fail closed. Identical live typed floating-point trees receive an exact-zero error certificate; reassociation, changed operation order, and nonzero ErrorBounded replay remain unsupported. A tensor reference must name the exact propagated accumulator result root and match its component count and semantic scalar before value/store refinement can pass. This composes the target-owned physical layout proof with the safe Rust/Verus semantic obligation; the reference is not treated as a hardware-layout oracle. mi300x lacks the fixed retained /opt runtime, so no referenced production compile has completed this gate and there is no fallback. Compiler extraction/projection and analysis-result or transformation soundness, target IEEE values, LLVM-or-later lowering, target instruction arithmetic, artifacts, launch, hardware, and performance remain outside the claim.

capabilities.label: Target finalization
capabilities.detail: Pinned historical qualification runs at compiler commit af0fd523e3b774377a9c5192cf0511e34fa19735 emitted gfx942 LLVM, linked HSACO, loaded it through fe2o3-host, and checked dynamic GEMM, row-softmax, fused-attention, and grouped-expert results against independent CPU references. Disassembly confirmed MFMA for matrix contractions and lane shuffles for reductions. Current main retains target-finalization components but the workload host applications fail closed until the sole Worker V3 production application path is wired. The measurements are historical correctness observations; only the GEMM lesson includes a matched direct HIP comparison, and it does not claim a speed advantage. Protected release authority and complete source-to-machine refinement remain separate.

capabilities.label: Runtime and persistent execution
capabilities.detail: At the published baseline, pure-Rust KFD topology, memory, queue, packet, and typed lifecycle foundations are present. The direct-KFD semantic observation boundary does not dispatch work: its redacted report exposes queue-lifecycle and resource facts only, with no dispatch identity, timing, KIR, workgroup, wave, lane, memory, or register observation. Production publication and load custody use Worker V3; Worker V2 application routing is retired and retained only in historical or qualification evidence. These records grant no completed load, launch, or persistent-execution authority; verified persistent execution and complete production runtime authority remain open in issues #135 and #137.

capabilities.label: Semantic debugging and profiling
capabilities.detail: Versioned semantic trace records, deterministic bounded hierarchy queries, capture planning, and import boundaries establish an agent-readable foundation. Queries page logical workgroups, Wave32/Wave64 waves, lanes, operation occurrences, memory accesses and regions, faults, provenance, and evidence; these are semantic views, not decoded hardware-wave observations. The importer can retain selected rocprofv3 JSON dispatch-envelope and timing observations, ATT manifest metadata without decoded events, and sparse normalized ROCgdb records with explicit unavailable fields. Separate exact progress analysis admits checked no-wrap positive induction, including a conservative multi-block straight-ring form. There is no debugger or profiler UI, general source/MIR/KIR/ISA map, counter or PC-sample ingestion, ATT decoding, structured ROCgdb state, capture comparison, or diagnosis authority yet. Issue #215 tracks those layers.

capabilities.label: Standalone CPU semantic simulation
capabilities.detail: The Linux-only fe2o3-kir-sim CLI securely admits exact verified canonical KIR V7 plus a strict typed request and executes the supported program with bounded deterministic CPU semantics, formal memory, checked accounting for retained heap capacity, copied results, and byte-level conflict observations. A versioned 245-byte WG64 fill fixture pins its exact KIR identity and complete output; a separate adapter can emit observation-only semantic traces for bounded hierarchy queries. The standalone path accepts no Rust source and is not an alternate compiler pipeline. It grants no source-to-KIR refinement, proof, race-freedom theorem, GPU equivalence, artifact or launch authority, timing, profiling, performance, or performance prediction. Unsupported language and memory features fail closed; issue #216 tracks broader semantics, schedules, and virtual runtime work.
